dedupe_keys.name: industrial alarm flood sequences dataset vinyl acetate monomer process

description: This dataset holds alarm flood sequences generated with a simulation model of a Vinyl Acetate Monomer (VAM) chemical process, offered as a benchmark for root cause identification of alarm floods and for alarm management research in complex industrial facilities. The IEEE DataPort page lists two authors at China University of Geosciences (Wuhan), CSV and XLSX data formats, a zipped data file of about 2.27 MB and a readme; it was created in December 2025 and last updated in March 2026 under the CC BY 4.0 licence. The page marks it a Standard Dataset, so files need an IEEE DataPort subscription (US$40 a month, free for IEEE Society members). Coverage is one simulated process. Caveats: the sequences are simulated, not taken from a real plant, and the number of sequences and alarm tags is not stated on the page read. For simulation it gives labelled alarm cascades to test operator decision support, alarm flood root cause analysis and the control-room side of process disruption models. Related catalogue records include the Tennessee Eastman process anomaly detection data and the NIST Tennessee Eastman wireless simulation code.
